title: Deeper/broader ACIS decoder lineage and standalone-to-AcDs qualification
scope: Refresh the already-admitted open-source ACIS/SAB candidate and its geometry/consumer boundaries.
Separate a bare ACIS/SAB decoder from DXF carrier parsing, DWG AcDs extraction/ownership, kernel semantics, and native consumer acceptance.
Audit parser/kernel lineage and release/provenance limits before adding an optional differential candidate.
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 and PAR-14 composed checkpoints without adding per-slice peer work or changing support claims.

method.evidenceRule: Mutable project documentation establishes declared scope and route only. No local, semantic, native, security, or interoperability result is established without pinned execution or a local reproducer.

evidence.topic: cadmpeg-codec-sat as an existing optional differential route
evidence.observed: The existing v0.6.1 candidate is a read-only bare ASM/ACIS SAT/SAB stream codec, not a DWG or DXF document reader. Its published ACIS/ASM score is L1 while its docs describe geometry transfer for a bounded supported subset. The source repository has a separate clean-room/provenance policy, but mutable main was not verified against the crate archive.
doesNotEstablish: A tested build or decoded result for this task's carrier profiles
Support for DWG section, AcDs DataStorage, record, owner, or entity mapping
Complete ACIS/SAB grammar or full B-rep semantics
Native consumer acceptance or platform qualification
evidence.planUse: Admit only as a candidate exact-payload differential decoder after a one-time source, package, dependency, license, platform, and profile fingerprint. Keep its L1 declaration and unsupported subset visible.

evidence.observed: cq-acis describes experimental SAT/SAB parsing and conversion to CadQuery/OpenCascade shapes. acis-core states that reference closure does not prove B-rep validity; inventor-kit consumes that same acis-core/acis-py-bridge lineage. cadmpeg-codec-sat is a different codec package, but its policy permits compatible open-source knowledge and its SAB notes identify ezdxf plus cadmpeg format notes as sources.
doesNotEstablish: That separate package names equal independent decoding algorithms or independent derivations
Three independent evidence votes from cq-acis, acis-core, and inventor-kit
B-rep validity merely from reference closure or a parser success result
evidence.planUse: Compare exact source/dependency lineage. Treat inventor-kit and cq-acis as one shared parser/model family. Treat cadmpeg as useful differential implementation evidence but not an oracle for fields whose knowledge lineage overlaps ezdxf or its own mutable notes.

evidence.topic: Native consumer and licensed kernel routes
evidence.observed: FreeCAD docs state stock DXF import does not read embedded ACIS solids and describe DWG as a converter-to-DXF handoff. CAD Assistant lists ACIS SAT/SAB import through commercial Open CASCADE components. OpenCADStudio advertises ACIS entity tessellation but its codec is associated with the ACadRust lineage already in the plan.
doesNotEstablish: Native Linux or Windows execution in this environment
That a stock FreeCAD pass validates ACIS semantics
An open-source ACIS import component in the default OCCT/FreeCAD build
An independent DWG parser from an ACadRust-derived consumer
evidence.planUse: Keep FreeCAD native qualification scoped to its actual 2D import route. Any 3D consumer check names the exact application, component, license, kernel, version, and operation; commercial routes stay optional.

evidence.observed: LibreDWG documents multiple input/output and round-trip fuzz modes. The advisory describes an R13-R2000 class-count resource-exhaustion case fixed in LibreDWG 0.14. The existing plan already records the issue and a local ODA-backed length-delimited class-parser architecture audit.
doesNotEstablish: Current peer harness health from historical HACKING text
A reason to add fuzzing or sanitizer runs to each implementation slice
evidence.planUse: Retain PAR-14's bounded count/length/progress review and scheduled route-matched fuzz checkpoint; do not create a duplicate peer-shaped finding or import a peer corpus file.

limitations: GitHub, docs.rs, and project documentation are mutable; no commit, package archive hash, or installed binary was captured in this research-only pass.
No candidate decoder, OCCT commercial component, FreeCAD build, or native consumer was installed or executed.
A generated geometry control is a proposed qualification method, not evidence until executed against independently calculated expectations.
No route closes DWG AcDs extraction/ownership, independent ACIS semantics, or native Linux/Windows qualification.
